name: 95616 · Davis, CA
findings: ZIP 95616 (Davis) has 270 nonprofit organizations. 165 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95616 (Davis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95616 (Davis) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
